description: Client-side script defining the PointOfSale.Payment class for handling payment UI and logic in a POS system within ERPNext.
external_methods: __('You don't have enough points to redeem.')

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.Payment
classes.description: Class managing the POS payment interface, including rendering payment options, handling user interactions, and processing payments.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the payment component with event handlers and UI elements.

methods.name: init_component
methods.description: Sets up the payment component by preparing DOM, initializing numpad, binding events, and attaching shortcuts.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Creates and appends the main payment HTML structure to the wrapper.

methods.name: make_invoice_fields_control
methods.description: Fetches POS settings and dynamically creates invoice fields controls.

methods.name: initialize_numpad
methods.description: Sets up the numeric keypad for amount entry.

methods.name: on_numpad_clicked
methods.description: Handles numpad button clicks, updating the input value and UI focus.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds various UI events for payment mode selection, form updates, and order submission.

methods.name: setup_listener_for_payments
methods.description: Listens for real-time phone payment responses and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: auto_set_remaining_amount
methods.description: Automatically fills in the remaining amount for the selected payment mode.

methods.name: attach_shortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcuts for submitting order and switching payment modes.

methods.name: toggle_numpad
methods.description: Placeholder for toggling numpad visibility (not implemented).

methods.name: render_payment_section
methods.description: Renders payment options, invoice fields, totals, and default focus.

methods.name: edit_cart
methods.description: Switches UI to edit cart mode.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Prepares UI for checkout process.

methods.name: toggle_remarks_control
methods.description: Shows or hides the remarks input control.

methods.name: render_payment_mode_dom
methods.description: Renders the list of payment modes and controls.

methods.name: focus_on_default_mop
methods.description: Focuses on the default payment mode control.

methods.name: attach_cash_shortcuts
methods.description: Adds quick cash amount shortcuts for cash payments.

methods.name: get_cash_shortcuts
methods.description: Calculates quick cash amount options based on total.

methods.name: render_loyalty_points_payment_mode
methods.description: Displays loyalty points redemption option if applicable.

methods.name: render_add_payment_method_dom
methods.description: Adds UI for adding new payment methods if order is unpaid.

methods.name: update_totals_section
methods.description: Updates the display of total, paid, and remaining amounts.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the entire payment component.
